description: Check a whole dependency list in one call. Pass up to 10 ecosystem:name pairs (npm, pypi, cargo, go, maven, nuget) and get per-package existence, verdict and flags (not-found, deprecated, known advisories, very new or unmaintained), plus a summary. Catches hallucinated or typosquat package names an AI coding agent might install. Bad input is not charged. Costs $0.01 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

packages.description: Comma-separated ecosystem:name pairs, max 10, e.g. npm:left-pad,pypi:requests

name: package-audit
